ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Water its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Transporting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Soil and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 100 °C

2. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

5. D — Glucose and oxygen

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

8. C — newton (N)

9. B — Ice melting to water

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

12. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animals resources; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
